text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Angolan Public Works Minister Pedro de Castro van Dunem, on a visit to Portugal, said Angola was worried about an influx of refugees from Zaire and encouraged the intervention of the Organisation of African Unity.
- The U.N. special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, returns to Luanda on Tuesday after a 15-day holiday.
- Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia begins a two-day visit to Angola on Tuesday and is expected to meet President Jose Eduardo dos Santos and other senior government officials.
